summary: "Notes on building software carefully: a build log, opportunity spotting, AI governance, and analysis."

I write here about the software I build and the decisions behind it. Most posts start as notes from a real project and get cleaned up enough to be useful to someone else.

The four threads I keep coming back to are the build log (what I shipped and why), opportunities worth naming out loud, the governance questions that come with using AI in real work, and the occasional deeper analysis when a topic deserves more than a paragraph.

Everything here is written in English and Romanian. If a piece exists in both languages, you can switch between them from the piece itself.
